title: Milonine attenuates the lipopolysaccharide-induced acute lung injury in mice by modulating the Akt/NF-kappaB signaling pathways.
authors: Bernardo, Larissa R; Ferreira, Laercia Karla D P; Ferreira, Larissa A M P; Vieira, Cosmo Isaias D; Oliveira, Joao Batista DE; Lima, Louise M DE; Alves, Adriano Francisco; Araujo, Rubens S; Maia, Mayara S; Scotti, Marcus T; Barbosa Filho, Jose Maria; Piuvezam, Marcia Regina
journal: Anais da Academia Brasileira de Ciencias
one_liner_zh: 该文研究生物碱Milonine通过TLR4/MD2-Akt/NF-κB通路缓解小鼠急性肺损伤，仅涉及蛋白-小分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Acute lung injury is an inflammation that triggers acute respiratory distress syndrome with perialveolar neutrophil infiltration, alveolar-capillary barrier damage, and lung edema. Activation of the toll-like receptor 4 complex (TLR4/MD2) and its downstream signaling pathways are responsible for the cytokine storm and cause alveolar damage. Due to the complexity of this pulmonary inflammation, a defined pharmacotherapy has not been established. Thus, this study evaluated the anti-inflammatory potential of milonine, an alkaloid of Cissampelos sympodialis Eichl, in an experimental model of lung inflammation. BALB/c mice were lipopolysaccharide-challenged and treated with milonine at 2.0 mg/kg. Twenty-four hours later, the bronchoalveolar fluid, peripheral blood, and lungs were collected for cellular and molecular analysis. The milonine treatment decreased the cell migration (mainly neutrophils) to the alveoli, the pulmonary edema, and the cytokine levels (IL-1beta, IL-6, TNF-alpha). The systemic IL-6 level was also reduced. The milonine docking analysis demonstrated hydrophobic interaction at TLR4/MD2 groove with Ile124 and Phe126 amino acids. Indeed, the alkaloid downregulated the kinase-Akt and NF-kappaB through TLR4/MD2. Therefore, milonine is an effective inflammatory modulator being a potential molecule for the treatment of lung inflammation.
abstract_zh: 急性肺损伤是一种炎症，可引发急性呼吸窘迫综合征，伴有肺泡周围中性粒细胞浸润、肺泡-毛细血管屏障损伤及肺水肿。Toll样受体4复合物（TLR4/MD2）的激活及其下游信号通路是导致细胞因子风暴和肺泡损伤的原因。由于这种肺部炎症的复杂性，尚未确立明确的药物治疗方案。因此，本研究在实验性肺炎症模型中评估了米洛宁（milonine）——一种来自锡生藤（Cissampelos sympodialis Eichl）的生物碱——的抗炎潜力。BALB/c小鼠接受脂多糖刺激，并以2.0 mg/kg剂量给予米洛宁治疗。24小时后，收集支气管肺泡液、外周血和肺组织进行细胞和分子分析。米洛宁治疗减少了细胞迁移（主要是中性粒细胞）至肺泡、肺水肿及细胞因子水平（IL-1β、IL-6、TNF-α）。全身性IL-6水平也降低。米洛宁的分子对接分析显示，其在TLR4/MD2沟槽中与Ile124和Phe126氨基酸发生疏水相互作用。确实，该生物碱通过TLR4/MD2下调了激酶Akt和NF-κB。因此，米洛宁是一种有效的炎症调节剂，是治疗肺部炎症的潜在分子。
